Formula:
p_i = (W_i + 0.5*D_i + 0.5)/(N_i + 1)
R_i = label_i + 400*log10(p_i/(1-p_i))
v_i = (400/ln(10))^2/(N_i*p_i*(1-p_i))
weight_i = 1/v_i
R_pool = sum(weight_i*R_i)/sum(weight_i)
SE_pool = 1/sqrt(sum(weight_i))
CI95 = [R_pool - 1.96*SE_pool, R_pool + 1.96*SE_pool]

Bootstrap.Method: whole-opening jointly across anchors, both colors retained; percentile CI with linear interpolation (type 7)

Interpretation: Local historical-label calibration, conditional on fixed anchors; no official CCRL rating.
Both intervals omit label uncertainty, OS/time-control transfer, shared openings, correlated Counter versions and non-transitivity.
The supplemental bootstrap never replaces the primary decision rule.
Questions: Bootstrap interval construction is not specified; supplemental percentile interval uses linear interpolation (type 7).
